about.description: Equity-index perpetual market tracking a large-cap U.S. equity benchmark commonly used as a proxy for the U.S. public stock market. Users get synthetic index exposure rather than ownership of constituent shares, with pricing referencing dated index futures and is converted into an implied spot-style oracle. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the cash namespace, but are operated by Dreamcash rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
